accepted_revision: 关键操作台、显示屏和操纵底座由 Blender 精细建模；Meshy 只作舱内装饰。
authored_parts: Three curved CRT glass surfaces with separate bezels and gaskets
Navigation keypad and function keys with individual moving keycaps
Knurled rotary knobs with angle ranges
Three independent throttle levers and authored slotted base
Joystick grip, separate trigger and top button, authored gaiter/base

interaction_api.stable_id: StableId is unique per interactive element.
interaction_api.select: Raycast with QueryTriggerInteraction.Collide; use the component on the hit collider.
interaction_api.press: TryActivate(worldOrigin); call Release() when releasing a button.
interaction_api.movement: Each articulated part retains an independent pivot and its captured neutral pose.
interaction_api.input: No player/controller or input binding is imposed. Connect these APIs to the project's own interaction/input system.

screen_api.editable_texture: SetTexture accepts a Texture or RenderTexture.

verification_boundary: Editor import, saved scene/prefab inspection, visual rendering and direct articulation checks. No Play Mode or player build acceptance.
